pupils.title: BUILD · Tees Estuary Field Investigation (instrument)
pupils.description: Biology instrument, not a lesson: run an estuary survey — match method to zone, pair chemistry with biological evidence and give a qualified verdict.
pupils.subject: Science · Teesside

pupils.title: BUILD · Wilton Carbon Process Control (instrument)
pupils.description: Chemistry instrument, not a lesson: trace carbon through fractional distillation and cracking, keeping the atom ledger balanced.

pupils.title: BUILD · Tees Bay Wind Operations (instrument)
pupils.description: Physics instrument, not a lesson: operate a turbine inside its safe power envelope — the cube law, pitch control and the gap between available and electrical power.
pupils.subject: Science · Teesside

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN · Kitchen Programme PEQ Year Map & SoW (working towards, Entry 3 · Level 1 · Level 2 lanes)
pupils.description: The full-year, three-lane Kitchen Programme scheme of work: week-by-week GLH ledger per unit, staged milestones (Award by Christmas, Extended by Easter, Certificate by summer), and the sensitivity table re-based on the measured 40-minute period across the 1–7 period band with the derived seven-period rate marked live. Working towards — a unit is achieved only once assessed, IQA'd and EQA-sampled.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN · Kitchen Programme Cooking Handover (teacher frame)
pupils.description: The teacher frame for the kitchen year: what it is for, which block evidences which unit at which level, what paperwork is already provided, what the class teacher produces, and the five rules that do not bend (supervised bench, no diet or body framing, no pupil names in the repository, signed and dated evidence, working towards). Deliberately carries no recipes, menus, dishes or ingredients — those are the class teacher's.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN · Kitchen Programme Weekly Shells (38 weeks, print-first)
pupils.description: One printable page per week for the whole year: the block, the units and the exact assessment criteria due that week for each of the three lanes with their minima, the plan and review-point events falling due, and the evidence artefacts to collect — with the “what we are cooking this week” box left empty for the class teacher to fill.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN · Kitchen Programme Criteria by Week (Entry 3 · Level 1 · Level 2)
pupils.description: The criteria coverage matrix inverted: week by week and lane by lane, which criteria fall due and which named artefact holds the evidence. Built from the same mapping as the matrix in the same build, so the two pages cannot drift apart.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN · Kitchen Programme Weekly Completion Checklist
pupils.description: A week-by-week tick sheet for the class teacher: evidence collected, sheets signed by assessor and learner, and plan hours logged — with the 10-hour windows open that week named in the row and the qualification milestone weeks shaded.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN W7: A visitor, and the evidence we keep (Autumn 1 · week 7 · C136 · C150 · C180)
pupils.description: Predict what a visitor's working day involves, check it against what they say, and record one piece of portfolio evidence that can be signed off. Classic chassis (v2) with three print packs; teaches three workbook cells at once.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: BUILD ASDAN W15: Sign it off: my evidence folder (Autumn 2 · week 7 · C143 · C157 · C187)
pupils.description: Check a piece of evidence for the three marks (date, name, who saw it), add what is missing, and say what the team did, so the term's portfolio, Duke challenge and community evidence can be signed off. Classic chassis (v2) with three print packs.
pupils.subject: BUILD Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN W15: Bank it: Young Duke and the team (Autumn 2 · week 7 · C157 · C187)
pupils.description: Bank one piece of Young Duke or community evidence with its date, witness, name and line, and write a teamwork reflection that separates what the team did from what I did, so both can be signed off this term. Classic chassis (v2) with three print packs; the second week-15 GROW ASDAN deck, serving the two cells the PEQ deck does not.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW ASDAN W1: Choose my Young Duke challenge (Autumn 1 · week 1 · C144)
pupils.description: Rank the Young Duke challenge areas against what I can already do and what I want to get better at, and choose one to start, with the reason written in my own words. Classic chassis (v2) with three print packs.
pupils.subject: GROW Vocational & PfA

pupils.title: GROW Humanities W1: Beliefs and world views around us (Autumn 1 · week 1 · C60)

pupils.subject: Humanities

pupils.title: GROW Humanities W2: How beliefs shape who we are (Autumn 1 · week 2 · C61)
pupils.description: Sequence the chain from a belief to a choice to a habit to a part of who someone is, and describe one link in your own words. RE strand, classic chassis (v2) with three print packs.
pupils.subject: Humanities

pupils.title: LAUNCH Humanities W1: Belief, identity and belonging as an adult (Autumn 1 · week 1 · C200)

pupils.subject: Humanities

pupils.title: LAUNCH Humanities W2: Two world views side by side (Autumn 1 · week 2 · C201)
pupils.description: Spot the errors in a summary that mixes up the key beliefs of two world views, and rewrite it so each belief sits with the right view, with no view ranked above the other. RE and Ethics strand, classic chassis (v2) with three print packs.
pupils.subject: Humanities

pupils.title: BUILD Humanities W2: A special book, a special place (Autumn 1 · week 2 · C61)
pupils.description: Sort picture cards into books and places, then match each one to its faith word, using the cards on the table and a word bank. RE strand, classic chassis (v2) with three print packs.
pupils.subject: Humanities
